tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by two different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Google Cloud introduces Gemini AI agent for enterprise workflows. Reported by Tech Wire Asia: Google's Gemini agent automates enterprise tasks across apps and platforms.
DeepSeek's funding target exceeds 800 billion RMB, while Moonshot valued at 500 billion dollars. Still open, per 茉莉花新闻网: both companies aim for 2027 listings.
ChatGPT for Teens fails age detection and crisis alerts in new testing. Confirmed by The Indian Express: the app raises safety concerns for young users.
South Africa urges global rules to regulate military artificial intelligence and autonomous weapons. Reported by The Citizen: the country calls for human oversight and peace.
Nobel-winning scientist John Jumper leaves Google for Anthropic amid the talent race. Reported by Hindustan Times: Google DeepMind chief Demis Hassabis praised the move.
Free every hour.
